sources_summary: Church official facts-and-statistics pages, one per country, as of Dec. 31, 2025 (churchofjesuschrist.org/learn/facts-statistics/<country>).
http://ldschurchgrowth.blogspot.com/2026/04/country-by-country-membership.html (secondary source noting Brazil's overtake of Mexico).
method: Total Church membership, congregations (wards + branches), missions, and operating temples for the five Latin American countries with the largest Latter-day Saint populations, each pulled directly from that country's own official Church facts-and-statistics page as of Dec. 31, 2025 - a single-source snapshot, not a compiled timeline.
headline: Brazil surpassed Mexico in total membership in 2025 (by 1,073 members) to become the country with the most Latter-day Saints of any nation outside the United States.
